title: Matching Closure Signatures
goal: Specify parameter and value types so the closure parses and operates on string inputs.
hints: The argument passed to `parse_and_add` is a string slice `"42"`, not an owned `String`.
The closure returns `i32`, so adding an unsigned integer `10_u32` causes a type mismatch.
explanation: `"42"` is a string slice `&str`, so the closure parameter must accept `&str`. Annotated `String` produces `E0308` because string slices do not implicitly convert to owned strings. Using `i32` for the parameter produces `E0599` because `parse` is a string method. For `add_val`, adding `10_u32` or `"10"` triggers type mismatch `E0308` because integer addition requires matching types without implicit conversion.
